findings.title: Cancel refund rule contradicts the 24h rule in spec 001
findings.why: specs/001-rental-module/spec.md states the cancellation policy: no refund less than 24h before start, otherwise a full refund. `cancel` refunds in full at any time up to the start and 0 only after the start. A customer cancelling 2h before start gets a full refund where the spec says none. Spec 005 calls its policy 'assumed, to be confirmed', but the existing documented rule was not followed and the conflict is not reconciled.

findings.title: Spec 001 is stale after the later features
findings.why: It says cancellation is NOT implemented, but `cancel` now exists. It also says every period must be midnight-aligned, but hourly rentals now allow on-the-hour periods. It also says total = days x dailyPrice, but the long-stay discount now applies from 3 days.

findings.title: Spec 002 contradicts hourly periods
findings.why: It lists 'not midnight UTC' as an invalid period that throws. `availability` now accepts on-the-hour periods shorter than a day, as spec 004 FR-006 says. Spec 002 is not updated.

findings.title: Bad-period test passes for the wrong reason
findings.why: The 10:00 to 00:00 next-day period is 14h, so it is treated as hourly. Item b1 has no hourlyPrice, so it throws for that reason and not because of misalignment. The test does not check what it claims to check.

findings.title: `booked` map stores redundant fields
findings.why: Each entry keeps both `period` and separate copies of `startMs` and `endMs`, which hold the same values.
